title: A Seoul Research Exchange on Aging, Autonomy, and Technology
summary: A summer visit to Seoul National University emphasized sustained relationships with older adults in technology research.

sources.label: Read Chorong Park's original LinkedIn post

paragraphs.text: An August 19, 2026, reflection from Chorong Park looked back on a summer research visit to Seoul National University. Hosted by Hyunggu Jung's lab in the College of Nursing, Park shared recent work and joined an international group in conversation about technology and aging.

Her account focused on sustained engagement with older adults. Rather than treating participation as a single recruitment step, she described the importance of listening, building relationships, and returning to people's experiences over time.

The discussion connected human-computer and human-robot interaction with trust, privacy, autonomy, and technoageism. Park emphasized older adults' role as contributors to research and design, not simply recipients of technology developed elsewhere.

She also described exchanges with visiting researchers from Taiwan, including a follow-up conversation with Yung-Ju Chang of National Yang Ming Chiao Tung University. Those conversations opened possibilities for future visits and collaboration.
The 17-image gallery preserves the classroom presentation and moments of informal exchange from the original post. Together, they document a visit centered on learning across research communities.
